data_fields.name: resist_stun_status_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: stat, percent (100 minus stat scales the chance)

data_fields.name: decrease_stun_duration_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: stat, percent (100 minus stat scales the length)

data_fields.name: chance_base_per_mille
data_fields.donor_constant: chanceIn1000 passed by the caller (caller not read)

data_fields.name: cast_lock_in_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.2 (no interrupt when remaining cast is below this)

data_fields.name: interrupt_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: enum per skill row: Default, InterruptOnDamage, InterruptOnSkill (default for players), InterruptOnKnockback, NeverInterrupt

data_fields.name: sp_cost_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: SpCost int[] per skill row, cost = row x (100 + SpConsumption)/100

data_fields.name: cast_time_dex_scale
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.99^Dex, Dex above 100 counts double, no floor

best_idea: One resist curve (0.99 per stat point) scales both the chance and the length of a stun, with per-type stat multipliers (player x1.5, boss x2.5), plus a small interrupt-mode table each skill picks from.
decision_why: Take the resist curve and the interrupt-mode table. Add the one CC ladder from cell 1 because this stun has no diminishing step. Do not copy the pattern where a skill's numbers are hard-coded in its handler (BashHandler.cs 21-22) and the Params row is not read by the server.
acceptance: Server test: a player with Vit 50 hit by a 30% stun (chanceIn1000 = 300, no ResistStun, luck 0) is stunned about 14% of the time before the luck modifier and for about 2.35 s; a fourth stun from any source within 15 s applies no aura.
